# Native Screens

> Native Screens is a family-owned screen enclosure company serving Broward County and all of South Florida since 1972. The owner, Larry, runs the business directly — not a franchise or a call center. Services: pool enclosures (pool cages), screen enclosures, rescreens and screen repair, aluminum patio roofs, and super gutters. Licensed and insured. Free, no-pressure estimates. Phone: (954) 966-0163.

## Business facts
- Business name: Native Screens
- Founded: 1972 (50+ years in business)
- Owner: Larry
- Phone / text: (954) 966-0163
- Website: https://www.nativescreens.com
- Rating: 5.0 on Google
- Licensed and insured Florida contractor
- Area served: Broward County, Miami-Dade County, and Palm Beach County (South Florida)
- Primary cities: Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Coral Springs, Davie, Weston, Miramar, Plantation, Sunrise, Pompano Beach, Cooper City, Tamarac, Hallandale Beach, Dania Beach, Miami, Aventura, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach
- Services: pool enclosures, screen enclosures, pool cage rescreens, screen repair, screen door repair, pet-resistant screen, panoramic (picture-window) enclosures, pool cage painting and restoration, aluminum patio roofs, super gutters, storm/wind damage repair
- Typical pricing (South Florida): single torn screen panel $35–$250; screen door rescreen $85–$350; full pool cage rescreen $1,200–$4,500; new screen pool enclosure $5,000–$20,000+; patio/porch screen enclosure $2,000–$9,000
- What makes them different: family-owned since 1972, you deal directly with the owner, no salespeople or subcontractors, honest quotes, rescreens reuse your existing aluminum frame

## Services
- [Pool Enclosures (Pool Cages) in South Florida](https://www.nativescreens.com/pool-enclosures-south-florida.html): Custom pool cage new builds, replacements, and rescreens, built to Florida code.
- [Rescreens & Screen Repair](https://www.nativescreens.com/rescreens-screen-repair.html): Torn, sagging, or sun-rotted screens replaced fast, often in a day, reusing the existing frame.
- [Screen Enclosures & Patio Screen Rooms](https://www.nativescreens.com/screen-enclosures-patio-south-florida.html): Bug-free patio, porch, and lanai screen enclosures.
- [Aluminum Patio Roofs](https://www.nativescreens.com/aluminum-patio-roofs-south-florida.html): Insulated and pan aluminum patio covers for shade and storm protection.
- [Super Gutters](https://www.nativescreens.com/super-gutters-south-florida.html): Oversized seamless gutters for pool enclosures and patio roofs to handle heavy South Florida rain.
- [Screen Door Repair & Replacement](https://www.nativescreens.com/screen-door-repair-replacement.html): Rollers, hinges, latches, and torn screen-door panels fixed.
- [Pet-Resistant Screen Enclosures](https://www.nativescreens.com/pet-resistant-screen-enclosures.html): Tear-tough pet screen and pet doors for dogs and cats.
- [Panoramic (Picture Window) Pool Enclosures](https://www.nativescreens.com/panoramic-picture-window-pool-enclosures.html): Wide, uninterrupted views with fewer cross-bars.
- [Pool Cage Painting & Restoration](https://www.nativescreens.com/pool-cage-painting-restoration.html): Clean, treat, and repaint an old aluminum frame to look new.
- [All Services](https://www.nativescreens.com/services.html): Full list of what Native Screens builds and repairs.
